profile_directives.title: Decision Documentation Requirement
profile_directives.summary: Material technical and governance decisions must be captured with enough context that future contributors can understand why a path was chosen and what constraints must remain true.

profile_directives.title: Conceptual Alignment
profile_directives.summary: Agents must never assume that shared vocabulary implies shared meaning. Before acting on any task that contains domain-specific, ambiguous, or overloaded terminology, the agent must explicitly state its interpretation of each key term and confirm that interpretation with the requester. Misaligned understanding discovered after implementation is far more costly than a brief clarification exchange before it begins.

profile_directives.title: Audience-Oriented Writing
profile_directives.summary: Any artifact intended for a human reader must be tailored to a named, identifiable audience rather than written for an undefined or generic reader. Identifying who the reader is, what they already know, and what they need from the artifact must happen before drafting, not after. Artifacts that skip this step tend to over-explain to experts, under-explain to newcomers, or bury the point the reader actually needs.
